words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 这附近有便利店或者超市吗？(Zhè fùjìn yǒu biànlìdiàn huòzhě chāoshì ma?) — Is there a convenience store or supermarket nearby?
银行就在那家咖啡馆旁边。(Yínháng jiù zài nà jiā kāfēiguǎn pángbiān.) — The bank is right beside that cafe.
马路对面有一座大商场。(Mǎlù duìmiàn yǒu yí zuò dà shāngchǎng.) — Across the street there is a large shopping mall.
书店位于邮局和银行中间。(Shūdiàn wèiyú yóujú hé yínháng zhōngjiān.) — The bookstore is situated between the post office and the bank.
在前面的十字路口向左拐。(Zài qiánmiàn de shízì lùkǒu xiàng zuǒ guǎi.) — Turn left at the intersection ahead.
过马路一定要看红绿灯。(Guò mǎlù yídìng yào kàn hónglǜdēng.) — Always watch the traffic light when crossing the road.

words.English Meaning: to turn a corner / make a turn
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 走到路口右拐弯就到了。(Zǒu dào lùkǒu yòu guǎiwān jiù dào le.) — Walk to the intersection, turn right, and you're there.

words.English Meaning: to go straight / walk straight ahead
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 一直往前直走两百米。(Yìzhí wǎng qián zhí zǒu liǎng bǎi mǐ.) — Keep walking straight ahead for 200 meters.
师傅，请在前面的路口停一下。(Shīfu, qǐng zài qiánmiàn de lùkǒu tíng yíxià.) — Driver, please pull over at the intersection ahead.
地下二层有大型收费停车场。(Dìxià èr céng yǒu dàxíng shòufèi tíngchēchǎng.) — There is a large paid parking lot on basement level 2.
我打开电子地图查一下路线。(Wǒ dǎkāi diànzǐ dìtú chá yíxià lùxiàn.) — I'll open the electronic map to check the route.
跟着手机导航走就不会迷路。(Gēnzhe shǒujī dǎoháng zǒu jiù bú huì mílù.) — Follow the phone GPS and you won't get lost.

words.English Meaning: to get lost / lose one's way
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我在这个陌生的城市迷路了。(Wǒ zài zhè ge mòshēng de chéngshì mílù le.) — I got lost in this unfamiliar city.
老人们在公园里打太极拳。(Lǎorénmen zài gōngyuán lǐ dǎ tàijíquán.) — The seniors are practicing Tai Chi in the park.
我想去中国银行换一点外币。(Wǒ xiǎng qù Zhōngguó Yínháng huàn yìdiǎn wàibì.) — I want to go to Bank of China to exchange some foreign currency.
邮局就在马路拐角处。(Yóujú jiù zài mǎlù guǎijiǎo chù.) — The post office is right at the street corner.
去药店买一盒止痛药。(Qù yàodiàn mǎi yì hé zhǐtòngyào.) — Go to the pharmacy to buy a box of painkillers.
车快没油了，找个加油站吧。(Chē kuài méi yóu le, zhǎo gè jiāyóuzhàn ba.) — The car is running low on gas, let's find a gas station.
过了这座大桥就是火车站。(Guò le zhè zuò dàqiáo jiù shì huǒchēzhàn.) — After crossing this big bridge is the train station.
从这里到机场的距离大概三十公里。(Cóng zhèlǐ dào jīchǎng de jùlí dàgài sānshí gōnglǐ.) — The distance from here to the airport is about 30 km.
住在这里坐地铁非常方便。(Zhù zài zhèlǐ zuò dìtiě fēicháng fāngbiàn.) — Living here makes taking the subway very convenient.
下班高峰期路上很容易堵车。(Xiàbān gāofēngqī lùshang hěn róngyì dǔchē.) — During the evening rush hour it gets traffic jammed easily.
我们在地铁站C出口见面吧。(Wǒmen zài dìtiězhàn C chūkǒu jiànmiàn ba.) — Let's meet at subway station Exit C.
商场主入口在东侧街道。(Shāngchǎng zhǔ rùkǒu zài dōng cè jiēdào.) — The mall's main entrance is on the east street.
这条道路正在进行维修施工。(Zhè tiáo dàolù zhèngzài jìnxíng wéixiū shīgōng.) — This road is currently undergoing repair work.
